notes: Builds differ only by VITE_INTENT_PREFETCH. Timing runs were serial, after tests and builds completed.
All browser contexts requested reducedMotion: reduce at a 1280x900 viewport.
Fresh-context runs include 0, 200, 500, and 1000 ms intent windows. Warm runs revisit the destination in the same document.
Browser request routing disables HTTP cache. Warm scenarios exercise same-document module and application JSON caches.
Warm source setup scrolls the target into view and waits for active requests plus 500 ms of quiet before the measured activation. Warm journey bytes include the initial visit and Back.
CDP encoded byte counts reflect local preview transfer, not production gzip transfer.
Pre-click byte counts show already transferred resources; abandoning an import can still incur its remaining transfer.
Activation is a synthetic element.click() executed in the page. This excludes input dispatch delay; separate intent long-task totals expose main-thread work.
Layout shifts include the full journey. Synthetic activation can count expected route layout changes; these are not field CLS, INP, or real-user percentiles.

Later validation found that selector polling inflated About page-ready timings. Retain these values as historical evidence. Use 2026-11-09-live-prefetch.json for corrected same-build production comparisons with trusted input and browser readiness timestamps.
